## Earlier research

### AI-supported teaching and educational governance

At the **iFLYTEK Education Technology Institute** in Bengbu, China, I contributed to *Individualized Teaching and Educational Governance Supported by Artificial Intelligence* (Grant IED2020-Z003; PI: Dr. Bang Qi Liu). I conducted field studies of smart-classroom adoption, designed teacher and principal interviews, analyzed qualitative evidence, and authored regional governance reports informing education policy and development strategies.

### Knowledge supply and deep learning in the “Internet+” era

At **Anhui Normal University**, I contributed to the Anhui Philosophy and Social Science Planning Project (Grant AHSKY2019D036; PI: Dr. Hehai Liu). My work included developing and validating an ECM-ISC-based survey, analyzing continued engagement with online learning, and applying regression and confirmatory factor analysis in R and SPSS. A related [first-author article](Publications/Publication1/ECMISC_Paper.qmd) appeared in 2021.
